title: St. Dionysius
alt: The upper half of a standing bearded figure in a bishop's mitre adorned with gold and red decoration and a richly patterned red vestment with gold trim. He holds a crozier, makes a blessing gesture with his right hand and supports a second head with his left hand, against a green background with a golden halo.

title: Madonna and Child with Saint Jerome, Saint Catherine of Alexandria, and Angels
alt: Mary holds the infant Jesus against a gold background. To the left, Saint Jerome, balding with a long white beard and a red robe, writes in a green-covered book with a feather quill. To the right, Saint Catherine of Alexandria holds a blue-covered book, a black quill pen and a fragment of a spiked wheel. Two angels look on.

title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
alt: Shown from the waist up against a gold background, a crowned woman in a garnet-red robe rests a book and a palm frond against a spiked wheel. A round gold brooch at her neck bears the letters S.K.A.T.E.R.I.N.A.
